title: Describing Differences between Text Distributions with Natural Language
findings: The system successfully generated accurate natural language descriptions for text distributions characterized by religious content. For the human annotation 'is religious', the system generated 'is religious', and for 'is against religion', it generated 'has a negative connotation towards religion', both receiving the highest similarity rating.
